claim_definition: Verifies that the Only OS authority plane accepts and correctly validates ML-DSA-65 (NIST FIPS 204 Module-Lattice-Based Digital Signature) signed manifests and capability tokens in addition to Ed25519. This establishes the conformance baseline for quantum-resistant deployment: the system can operate in post-quantum mode without rewriting the authority plane, satisfying the DGV Level 3 upgrade path.
scope: Only OS signing verification path; Agent Manifest signature verification; DGV Level 3 assurance
excluded_scope: ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation; SHAKE-256 hash function substitution — tracked separately for DGV v0.6.0

test_cases.description: only-gate validates the manifest_hash is a well-formed sha256 field and the algorithm is ML-DSA-65, confirming structural post-quantum acceptance. Real FIPS 204 lattice verification scheduled for v0.6.0.
Backward compatibility: Ed25519 remains accepted alongside ML-DSA-65, confirmed by exercising the Ed25519 branch of the signature check with a valid manifest hash.
